title: Clock offset can reverse a logged event order
method: Synthetic inputs: send at 100 ms, receive at 120 ms, host A offset +30 ms and host B offset -10 ms. Logged timestamps are 130 and 110 ms. Cross-host subtraction gives -20 ms although actual elapsed time is 20 ms. Values illustrate offsets, not measured clock quality.
alt: Clock offset can reverse a logged event order. Physical send: 100 milliseconds; Physical receive: 120 milliseconds; Recorded send: 130 milliseconds; Recorded receive: 110 milliseconds. Illustrative values.
